hardness.label: Very Hard
hardness.intro: The Tampa Water Department's 2025 water quality report put average total hardness at 12.3 GPG, and the city says it runs 8 to 17 GPG through the year. Click a neighbourhood to see what that means for your home.
hardness.reportNote: The Tampa Water Department's 2025 report gave a citywide average of 12.3 GPG (211 mg/L), and the city says it runs 8 to 17 GPG through the year. The U.S. Geological Survey rates over 180 mg/L as "Very Hard."
hardness.footnote: Hardness is the Tampa Water Department's citywide figure from its 2025 report; it moves with the season and can read higher or lower at your tap.

issues: White scale on faucets and showerheads
Spotting and film on glassware and dishes
Scale buildup in water heaters and appliances
Soap scum, dry skin and stiff laundry
